# VerilogDB SoC Integration Components | Module: dbg_sync_clk1_clk2
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk1: input (1-bit)
  • clk2: input (1-bit)
  • reset1: input (1-bit)
  • reset2: input (1-bit)
  • set2: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • sync_out: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module synchronizes a set signal between two distinct clock domains (clk1 and clk2) by double-flop sampling in each domain while managing reset and clearing signals to produce a stable output.

# VerilogDB Peripheral Interfaces | Module: ac97_soc
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • ps_ce: input (1-bit)
  • resume: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • suspended: output (1-bit)
  • sync: output (1-bit)
  • [5:0] out_le: output (6-bit)
  • [2:0] in_valid: output (3-bit)
  • ld: output (1-bit)
  • valid: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module manages AC'97 timing by generating synchronization signals and controlling slot latch enables, input validity, suspend detection, and resume signaling.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__sdlclkp_4
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • SCE: input (1-bit)
  • GATE: input (1-bit)
  • CLK: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • GCLK: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module instantiates a gated clock generator that produces a gated clock (GCLK) by controlling the clock (CLK) signal with scan enable (SCE) and gate (GATE) inputs while correctly managing power and ground connections.

# VerilogDB Other | Module: access_control
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • reset: input (1-bit)
  • load_password: input (1-bit)
  • pushButtonLoad_RNG: input (1-bit)
  • pushButtonLoad2: input (1-bit)
  • [3:0] passinput4bit: input (4-bit)
  • timeout: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • load_sig_RNG: output (1-bit)
  • load_sig_2: output (1-bit)
  • reconfig: output (1-bit)
  • enable: output (1-bit)
  • passredled: output (1-bit)
  • passgreenled: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements an access control state machine that authenticates a user via a predefined 4-bit password sequence and subsequently controls game start, pause, reconfiguration, timeout events, and corresponding LED and load signals.

# VerilogDB Security and Crypto Blocks | Module: aes_sbox
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] a: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] d: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements the AES S-box by mapping an 8-bit input to its corresponding 8-bit substitution value using a case statement.

# VerilogDB Custom Accelerators and IP Blocks | Module: butterfly_raw
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rstn: input (1-bit)
  • en: input (1-bit)
  • [23:0] xp_real: input (24-bit)
  • [23:0] xp_imag: input (24-bit)
  • [23:0] xq_real: input (24-bit)
  • [23:0] xq_imag: input (24-bit)
  • [15:0] factor_real: input (16-bit)
  • [15:0] factor_imag: input (16-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • valid: output (1-bit)
  • [23:0] yp_real: output (24-bit)
  • [23:0] yp_imag: output (24-bit)
  • [23:0] yq_real: output (24-bit)
  • [23:0] yq_imag: output (24-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a complex butterfly operation by multiplying one input with a twiddle factor, delaying the other input, and then computing sum and difference results while adjusting bit-width by discarding lower bits.

# VerilogDB Memory Components | Module: full_dp_ram
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk_a: input (1-bit)
  • wen_a: input (1-bit)
  • ren_a: input (1-bit)
  • [3:0] addr_a: input (4-bit)
  • [7:0] wdata_a: input (8-bit)
  • clk_b: input (1-bit)
  • wen_b: input (1-bit)
  • ren_b: input (1-bit)
  • [3:0] addr_b: input (4-bit)
  • [7:0] wdata_b: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] rdata_a: output (8-bit)
  • [7:0] rdata_b: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a full dual-port synchronous RAM allowing independent read and write operations on two ports, each with its own clock and control signals, by updating and reading from a shared memory array based on specified addresses and data inputs.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: isp_blc
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • pclk: input (1-bit)
  • rst_n: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] black_r: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] black_gr: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] black_gb: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] black_b: input (8-bit)
  • in_href: input (1-bit)
  • in_vsync: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] in_raw: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • out_href: output (1-bit)
  • out_vsync: output (1-bit)
  • [7:0] out_raw: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module performs sensor black-level correction on Bayer-pattern raw image data by using pixel and line parity to determine color format and subtract the corresponding black level before outputting synchronized, adjusted pixel values.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: hex_to_7seg
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [3:0] hex: input (4-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • a: output (1-bit)
  • b: output (1-bit)
  • c: output (1-bit)
  • d: output (1-bit)
  • e: output (1-bit)
  • f: output (1-bit)
  • g: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module converts a 4-bit hexadecimal input into seven output signals that appropriately control a seven-segment display to show digits 0 through F.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: multiplier_8bits_version8
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] A: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] B: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [15:0] product: output (16-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This Verilog module implements an 8-bit multiplier that forms partial products and reduces them using Kogge Stone adders, half adders, and full adders to compute a 16-bit product.

# VerilogDB Peripheral Interfaces | Module: vga_controller
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [63:0] boardR: input (64-bit)
  • [63:0] boardB: input (64-bit)
  • [63:0] boardM: input (64-bit)
  • [2:0] coordX: input (3-bit)
  • [2:0] coordY: input (3-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • vga_h_sync: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module generates VGA synchronization signals and renders an 8×8 Reversi board by drawing white, yellow, red, blue, or green squares based on the current move, valid moves, and board state.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__dlclkp_2
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • GATE: input (1-bit)
  • CLK: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • GCLK: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module wraps and instantiates a base clock gating cell by connecting clock, gate, and power signals to produce a gated clock signal for controlled clock distribution.

# VerilogDB Other | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__sdfbbn_2
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • D: input (1-bit)
  • SCD: input (1-bit)
  • SCE: input (1-bit)
  • CLK_N: input (1-bit)
  • SET_B: input (1-bit)
  • RESET_B: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • Q: output (1-bit)
  • Q_N: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module wraps an instance of a base flip-flop incorporating scan chain inputs (SCD, SCE), an inverted clock (CLK_N), asynchronous set/reset (SET_B, RESET_B), and complementary outputs (Q, Q_N), with all necessary power and ground connections.

# VerilogDB Security and Crypto Blocks | Module: xc_aessub_sbox_fwd
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] in: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] out: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements the forward AES S-box transformation using a combinational logic circuit composed of bitwise XOR, AND, and inversion operations, mapping an 8-bit input byte to a substituted 8-bit output byte according to the AES specification.

# VerilogDB Custom Accelerators and IP Blocks | Module: ztex_ufm1_15d3
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • fxclk_in: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] read: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] write: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module shifts incoming 8-bit data into a buffer for a mining engine that computes cryptographic hashes and nonces, then synchronizes and outputs the results via clock management using DCM and PLL.

# VerilogDB Memory Components | Module: fifotwoflag
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] din: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • full: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a FIFO that uses separate read and write pointers to control push and pull operations, updating addresses and generating full or empty flags based on pointer positions while transferring data between input and memory.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: pong_disp_top
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • hsync: output (1-bit)
  • vsync: output (1-bit)
  • [11:0] rgb: output (12-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module generates VGA synchronization signals and dynamically produces Pong game graphics by combining a VGA timing generator with a graphics generator, updating the RGB display output on each tick.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: add_unsigned_1439
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [31:0] A: input (32-bit)
  • B: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [31:0] Z: output (32-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a 32-bit unsigned adder, adding the 32-bit input A with the 1-bit input B by using a network of logic gates to compute bit-by-bit sums and propagate carries.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: alu
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] a: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] b: input (8-bit)
  • [2:0] sel: input (3-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [8:0] c: output (9-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The code implements an ALU that, based on a 3-bit selector, performs addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and shifts on the lower 7 bits of two 8-bit inputs while managing sign in a 9-bit output.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: dpll
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • SignalIn: input (1-bit)
  • MainClock: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • SignalOut: output (1-bit)
  • Positive: output (1-bit)
  • Lead: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a digital phase-locked loop by using a phase comparator assessing lead and lag between an input signal and clock, a variable-reset random walk filter generating positive and negative outputs, and a frequency divider synchronizing the output.

# VerilogDB Other | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__edfxtp
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • CLK: input (1-bit)
  • D: input (1-bit)
  • DE: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • Q: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a positive-edge triggered D flip-flop with a 2-to-1 multiplexer that conditionally selects between the previous output and new data D based on enable DE, buffering the result to Q.

# VerilogDB Security and Crypto Blocks | Module: xc_aessub
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clock: input (1-bit)
  • reset: input (1-bit)
  • flush: input (1-bit)
  • [31:0] flush_data: input (32-bit)
  • valid: input (1-bit)
  • [31:0] rs1: input (32-bit)
  • [31:0] rs2: input (32-bit)
  • enc: input (1-bit)
  • rot: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • ready: output (1-bit)
  • [31:0] result: output (32-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module performs AES S-box substitution on selected bytes from two 32-bit sources, conditionally reordering and encrypting or decrypting the bytes using either a single-cycle or multi-cycle approach based on a fast mode parameter.

# VerilogDB Custom Accelerators and IP Blocks | Module: fpu
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • enable: input (1-bit)
  • [1:0] rmode: input (2-bit)
  • [2:0] fpu_op: input (3-bit)
  • [63:0] opa: input (64-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [63:0] out: output (64-bit)
  • ready: output (1-bit)
  • underflow: output (1-bit)
  • overflow: output (1-bit)
  • inexact: output (1-bit)
  • exception: output (1-bit)
  • invalid: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a floating-point unit that registers inputs, directs addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division operations with integrated rounding and exception handling, and outputs a correctly rounded result with status flags after a defined number of clock cycles.

# VerilogDB Memory Components | Module: tangent_lut
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [1:0] quad: input (2-bit)
  • enable: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [1:0] degrees: input (2-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [63:0] data: output (64-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a tangent lookup table that outputs a 64-bit tangent value—with its sign bit set according to the quadrant—for a given degree input, updating the value on each positive clock edge when enabled.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: player
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • enable: input (1-bit)
  • tft_busy: input (1-bit)
  • draw: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • tft_dc: output (1-bit)
  • tft_transmit: output (1-bit)
  • busy: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module manages the animation, rotation, and rendering of a player sprite on a TFT display by processing pixel counters, background updates, and directional inputs to generate precise display commands and update coordinate positions.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__lpflow_clkbufkapwr_8
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • A: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • X: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module instantiates a low-power clock buffer that transfers input A to output X while handling power and ground connections through its dedicated pins.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: kogge_stone_3
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [2:0] in1: input (3-bit)
  • [2:0] in2: input (3-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [2:0] sum: output (3-bit)
  • cout: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module implements a 3-bit Kogge-Stone adder that computes binary sums and a carry-out by generating and propagating signals through gray and black cells using a parallel-prefix approach.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: cde_clock_gater
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk_in: input (1-bit)
  • enable: input (1-bit)
  • atg_clk_mode: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • clk_out: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module gates the input clock by latching an OR of enable signals when the clock is low and AND’ing the latched result with the clock, so that the output is active only when the clock is high and the enable condition is met.

# VerilogDB Other | Module: synchronous_asynchronous_reset
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • in: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • out_async: output (1-bit)
  • out_sync: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements two registers driven by clk, one using a synchronous reset and the other an asynchronous reset, setting the respective output to zero when rst is asserted and otherwise updating it with the input value.

# VerilogDB Security and Crypto Blocks | Module: sbox1
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [4:0] in: input (5-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [1:0] out: output (2-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a fixed substitution box (S-box) by mapping each 5-bit input to one of 32 predetermined 2-bit output values using a case statement.

# VerilogDB Custom Accelerators and IP Blocks | Module: mac_5
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [39:0] i_1: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] i_2: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] i_3: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] i_4: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] i_5: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] w_1: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] w_2: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] w_3: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] w_4: input (40-bit)
  • [39:0] w_5: input (40-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [23:0] out_data: output (24-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module splits five input and five weight vectors into 25 segments, multiplies each corresponding pair using dedicated multiplier units, and sums all partial products into a single accumulated output.

# VerilogDB Memory Components | Module: fifo_cdc
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk_write: input (1-bit)
  • clk_read: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] data_in: input (8-bit)
  • write_en: input (1-bit)
  • read_en: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] data_out: output (8-bit)
  • fifo_empty: output (1-bit)
  • fifo_full: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This code implements a dual-clock FIFO that transfers data between separate write and read clock domains, managing write/read pointers and FIFO status flags to indicate fullness or emptiness.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: gray_sync2d
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [4:0] i_ptr: input (5-bit)
  • des_clk: input (1-bit)
  • des_rst_n: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [4:0] o_ptr: output (5-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a two-stage synchronizer that transfers a multi-bit input pointer through a temporary register to an output register on the destination clock, asynchronously resetting both registers when the reset signal is deasserted.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__einvp
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • A: input (1-bit)
  • TE: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • Z: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module wraps an inverter with an enable input, connecting power, ground, and body bias signals to an underlying instance that produces an inverted output Z from input A when TE is active.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__or4b
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • A: input (1-bit)
  • B: input (1-bit)
  • D_N: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • X: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module instantiates a sky130_fd_sc_hd__or4bb gate, effectively implementing a four-input OR function where inputs C_N and D_N are internally inverted before ORing with A and B, with appropriate power and ground connections.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: e203_subsys_gfcm
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • test_mode: input (1-bit)
  • clk0_rst_n: input (1-bit)
  • clk1_rst_n: input (1-bit)
  • sel1: input (1-bit)
  • clk0: input (1-bit)
  • clk1: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • clkout: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module synchronizes and cross-couples two clock domains using multi-stage flip-flop delays and gated enables to select and combine their outputs into a single clock signal.

# VerilogDB Other | Module: divider2
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • D: input (1-bit)
  • CLK: input (1-bit)
  • ENABLE: input (1-bit)
  • RES: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • Q: output (1-bit)
